usage_notes: Official docs captured 2026-08-19: Token Plan personal subscription, OpenAI-compatible base URL https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1, Beijing region only, Credits metering with a 7-day rolling quota (Lite 2500 / Standard 10000 / Pro 40000 Credits).

Subscription keys are sk-sp- prefixed and isolated from pay-as-you-go keys: the payg PVI_PROBE_BAILIAN_API_KEY and the payg workspace host must never be used against this endpoint, and the sk-sp- key must never be sent to the payg endpoint; mixing does not deduct plan quota by design.
Subscription renewal replaces the API key (official FAQ); after each renewal the key in .env must be reconfigured before routes degrade with auth failures.

Operator-accepted ToS gray zone (mirrors the mimo token-plan precedent): the personal plan is documented for interactive use in coding/agent tools and forbids API-automation backends and non-interactive batch calls; the operator directed onboarding on 2026-08-19 knowing this clause, and this platform forwards interactive coding-tool traffic only.

Identity separation: model names overlap with the pay-as-you-go bailian-cn-beijing routes (e.g. qwen3.8-max, glm-5.2), but subscription endpoint and payg endpoint are different identities per the runbook; never mapped or cross-qualified.
No per-token list price applies (Credits subscription), so no pricing file exists for this provider and ledger cost estimates are intentionally unknown (pricing_missing), never zero.
